name: Accordion
summary: Disclosure list. Each row is a <details>/<summary> with a Lumen-chrome chevron at the END (per AGENTS.md hard rule 14 — native disclosure marker is suppressed via .lumen-summary). Two modes — single (only one row open at a time, accordion-style) and multiple (rows open independently, disclosure-list-style).

type.description: single: opening row N closes row N-1 (canonical FAQ behavior). multiple: rows are independent disclosures.

value.description: Controlled active row id (single mode) or array of ids (multiple mode).

collapsible.description: single mode only. When false, at least one row stays open. Use for nav contexts where one section is always expanded.

variant.description: plain: hairline border between rows (default; FAQ pattern). card: each row gets a Card surface (settings groups). ghost: no chrome, only the chevron rotates (sub-navigation).

iconPosition.description: Lumen default: chevron at the END (matches reading flow). start places it before the summary (less common; only for very dense lists).

keyboard: Tab - move focus to next/prev summary
ArrowDown - move focus to next summary
ArrowUp - move focus to previous summary
rules: Use the semantic <details>/<summary> primitive — it ships keyboard, focus, and SR semantics for free.

Per AGENTS.md hard rule 14 — apply class='lumen-summary' (or Tailwind list-none) on every <summary> that paints its own end-of-summary chevron. The .lumen-summary rule suppresses the native disclosure marker on every browser (modern: list-style: none; pre-2022 webkit: ::-webkit-details-marker { display: none }).

When using shadcn / Radix Accordion (button-based) instead of <details>, the trigger needs aria-expanded and aria-controls={contentId}; the content needs role='region' and aria-labelledby={triggerId}.
Honor prefers-reduced-motion: the height animation collapses to an instant show/hide; the chevron rotation drops to instant flip.
Single mode: the open row's content has aria-current='true' to disambiguate for SR users navigating with rotor.

do: Use single mode for FAQ-style content where only one answer at a time matters.
Use multiple mode for settings / disclosure lists where users may want several open at once.
Lead summaries with the question or noun the answer addresses ('What's included in Pro?').
Pair with a CodeBlock or RichTextEditor inside the content for docs accordions.
Animate height — use grid-template-rows: 0fr → 1fr trick for smooth opens (no measured-height jank).
dont: Don't put critical info inside a closed accordion row on first load. Disclosure delays it.
Don't paint the chevron in lime — chrome, not action. Use text.tertiary at rest, text.primary on hover/open.
Don't combine with a Tabs control on the same surface — the user has too many disclosure moves.
Don't write summaries longer than one line. Truncation hides intent.
Don't forget .lumen-summary — without it, native triangles double up with your chevron (per hard rule 14).

changelog.note: Initial Accordion contract. <details>/<summary>-based primitive. .lumen-summary class suppresses native disclosure marker per AGENTS.md hard rule 14. Three variants (plain / card / ghost).
